researchNote: Ranked for the actual trip problem: five adults, one night, room access around 08:00–09:00 on 15 Sep, minimal luggage handling, easy Dadar return, and low group cost. Published rates are signals only until the property quotes 15→16 Sep for five adults.

stayWindow.planningEnvelope: Target ≤ ₹8,000 total for the group including any early-access charge; do not treat this as a confirmed expense.
stayWindow.selectionRule: Accept the first candidate that confirms the exact five-adult room arrangement, guarantees morning room access, has AC + private bathroom + hot water, and gives a final tax-inclusive group quote. Early access matters more than a slightly cheaper advertised rate.

decisionProtocol: Call Option 01 first. Its own published terms explicitly allow check-in/check-out to be scheduled to guest requests, making it the strongest match to the 08:00–09:00 recovery requirement.
Ask for the final five-adult total, exact bed layout, early-access charge, and whether five backpacks can be held after checkout until 04:30 on 17 Sep.
If the answer is not an explicit yes, move immediately to the next option. Do not book based on 'subject to availability' when the recovery block depends on it.
After you report a confirmed property, delete the rejected candidates, promote the winner into the canonical itinerary/map, and replace the planning envelope with the real amount.
callChecklist: Five adults, one night: 15 Sep → morning 16 Sep.
Can you GUARANTEE room access between 08:00 and 09:00 on 15 Sep? If yes, what is the exact extra charge?
What exact room/bed combination will legally accommodate all five adults?
Give the final total including taxes, extra-person/bed charges and early check-in.
Confirm AC, attached/private bathroom and hot water for the room(s).
Can you hold five backpacks after checkout on 16 Sep until about 04:30 on 17 Sep, and will someone physically release them at that time?
Can the booking/early-access promise be sent by WhatsApp, SMS or email before payment?

stays.name: City Guest House · Dadar East
stays.fit: Best match for early access + five-person budget
stays.address: 3, West Wing, 1st Floor, Framroz Court, Dadasaheb Phalke Marg, Dadar East, Mumbai 400014
stays.stationAccess: About a 2-minute walk from Dadar railway station in current Google hotel data; the property is on Dadasaheb Phalke Marg beside the station area.
stays.groupFit: Current inventory data lists a Superior Deluxe room for up to 5 guests; the hotel's own site publishes four room categories including Superior Deluxe.
stays.earlyCheckIn: Most important finding: the hotel's own terms state check-in and checkout timings can be scheduled as per guest requests at any time of day. This is still not a reservation guarantee until they confirm your 08:00–09:00 date/time.
stays.priceNote: Official site: rooms start at ₹3,600; Triple Deluxe ₹4,500; Superior Deluxe ₹5,500. Use ₹5,500 only as a published starting signal, not the 15 Sep final price.
stays.bagHold: Not reliably published. Ask for 16→17 backpack hold and 04:30 release in the same call.
stays.why: It nearly removes the Dadar station → hotel transfer, has a documented flexible-timing policy, and appears capable of putting the full group in one larger room instead of buying multiple rooms.
stays.watch: Google's default listing still shows noon check-in. Get the 08:00–09:00 promise in writing before paying.

stays.name: Hotel Avon Ruby · Dadar East
stays.address: 87, Naigaum Cross Road, Dadar East, Mumbai 400014
stays.stationAccess: OpenStreetMap-derived data places it roughly 480 m south of Dadar station; the official hotel site describes the station as a few minutes away.
stays.groupFit: Booking inventory currently lists a Family Suite with 2 king beds + 2 sofa beds and capacity 6+, while the hotel's official site confirms large Suite Rooms. Verify the exact five-adult configuration directly.
stays.earlyCheckIn: Current hotel-booking policy says early check-in is subject to availability. That is not enough for this trip unless the hotel explicitly reserves the morning access for you.
stays.priceNote: Two-adult online rates around the trip window are roughly mid-₹4k/night, but that is not comparable to a five-adult Family Suite. Ask direct for the suite total.
stays.bagHold: 24-hour front desk is listed by current booking sources; baggage storage must still be confirmed, especially 04:30 release.
stays.why: If the Family Suite is available, five people may fit in one room while staying extremely close to Dadar, which can beat seemingly cheaper hotels that require two or three rooms.
stays.watch: Do not accept 'early check-in subject to availability'. Require a date-specific guarantee.

stays.name: Ramee Guestline · Dadar East
stays.address: Plot No. 3, Kohinoor Road, Opp. Swaminarayan Temple, Dadar East, Mumbai 400014
stays.stationAccess: The hotel's own current site states Dadar Railway Station is 100 m away.
stays.groupFit: Current marketplace room inventory includes larger Club-room variants advertised for up to 4–5 adults. Confirm the exact legal bedding/occupancy directly before assuming one room is enough.
stays.earlyCheckIn: No public 08:00 guarantee found. Use the official WhatsApp/phone to negotiate and obtain a written confirmation.
stays.priceNote: Current two-adult public rates are materially higher than City Guest House/Avon Ruby. Treat this as the reliability fallback, not the default budget choice.
stays.bagHold: Current amenity listings include luggage assistance, a cloak room and 24-hour reception, making this the strongest hotel-based bag-hold fallback if they confirm 04:30 release.
stays.why: Very close to the station, direct official WhatsApp, stronger service infrastructure and hotel cloak-room facilities make it a good fallback when the cheaper options cannot guarantee the exact timing.
stays.watch: Likely the most expensive of the three; only use it if the morning-access or luggage guarantees justify the premium.

excludedStays.name: Hotel Parklane · Dadar East
excludedStays.reason: Good location and inexpensive per-room signals, but no strong public evidence of flexible 08:00 access and five adults may require multiple rooms. It loses to City Guest House on the actual constraint set.

excludedStays.name: Kohinoor Lodge · Dadar East
excludedStays.reason: Excellent station proximity and low-budget positioning, but materially weaker room/bathroom review signals. Kept out of the operational top three rather than making cleanliness/private-bath quality a trip risk.

luggage.principle: Keep Dadar as the luggage hub. Bags should make only four intentional moves: Bandra→Dadar on arrival, Dadar→hotel after sunrise, hotel→Dadar/hold at checkout, hold→return train.
luggage.referenceBudget: Central Railway's digital-cloak-room rollout used ₹30 per bag for the first 24 hours. Five bags therefore reference to ₹150 per storage period; keep the existing ₹200 planned amount as a conservative buffer until 2026 station pricing is rechecked.

options.name: Dadar Digital Smart Cloak Room
options.cost: Published Central Railway rollout rate: ₹30 per bag for first 24h; later reporting states ₹40 for each subsequent 24h. Keep ₹200 planned per five-bag storage block until current tariff is confirmed.
options.rules: Digital lockers use passenger travel details/PNR, payment and a barcode receipt for retrieval. Railway cloak-room rules require genuine passengers and securely packed/locked baggage.
options.use: Best 14→15 solution. Also best 16→17 solution if current 04:30 retrieval access is reconfirmed.
options.evidence: Central Railway introduced Dadar as part of its digital smart cloak-room system; later Central Railway reporting cited 160 Dadar lockers. Original rollout documentation states 24-hour operator support.
options.watch: The infrastructure is well evidenced, but a current official 2026 notice with exact Dadar access/maintenance hours was not found. Confirm 04:30 retrieval shortly before travel.

options.name: Confirmed hotel's overnight baggage hold
options.cost: Ask for complimentary hold; get any charge in writing.
options.rules: Get explicit permission for five backpacks, overnight storage after checkout, and a named 04:30 release time.
options.use: Can eliminate the second railway-storage transaction entirely if the chosen Dadar hotel guarantees overnight hold and 04:30 pickup.
options.watch: 24-hour reception does not automatically mean unattended luggage can be released at any hour. Ask the exact question.

options.name: Lugsto · Dadar fallback
options.cost: Rates vary by partner/location; use only after seeing the live Dadar partner and total.
options.rules: Book online; the exact partner address and operating hours are supplied with the booking. Photo ID is required.
options.use: Non-rail fallback if Dadar railway storage is unavailable.
options.watch: Do not use for the 16→17 block unless the selected Dadar partner explicitly supports the 04:30 collection time.

2026-09-14: Bandra Terminus → Dadar East: take one direct cab with all backpacks. This avoids hauling luggage from Bandra Terminus to the suburban station just to save a small fare.
Dadar → luggage drop → Lalbaug: complete the bag handoff once, then use one short cab to Lalbaug. If Lalbaug is impossible, continue directly to Siddhivinayak instead of returning to Dadar.
Keep the rest of 14 Sep in central Mumbai. Do not go to South Mumbai and back before the overnight Uran transfer.
For Danda Beach, pre-book the overnight road ride and the return pickup together. That is the one long transfer the plan intentionally accepts.
2026-09-15: Danda Beach → Dadar: use the pre-arranged return ride, retrieve bags once, then walk to the confirmed Dadar East hotel.
Nothing goes between bag pickup and hotel recovery. Morning sleep/shower/charging is operationally more valuable than squeezing in another attraction.
After recovery: hotel → Siddhivinayak directly. If Lalbaug became the fallback, hotel → Lalbaug directly. Do not route through another hub first.

Keep the evening around Dadar/Prabhadevi/Worli and return to the hotel once. Save Colaba/Fort/Marine Drive for 16 Sep so the city is covered in geographic clusters rather than repeated north-south crossings.
2026-09-16: Checkout → bag handoff should be walkable: selected hotel hold first if 04:30 release is guaranteed, otherwise Dadar digital cloak room.
From the Dadar East/Central side, take a direct Central local toward CSMT, then one short final cab to the Taj/Sea Lounge area. This avoids crossing Dadar simply to use the Western line.
Arrive around the Taj area with a real buffer before the fixed 11:45 Sea Lounge booking.
After Sea Lounge use one outward-to-homeward South Mumbai chain: Colaba → Kala Ghoda/Fort → Marine Drive → progressively north later at night. Do not return to Dadar in the middle of the day.
2026-09-17: After midnight, keep drifting north rather than starting any new southbound loop.
Use one final cab to Dadar when local-train timing becomes inconvenient; target the luggage point around 04:30.
Retrieve bags once, then go directly to the return-train platform buffer for the 05:52 departure.
